what: Unit suite executed inside the pinned official CHIA image, read-only mount, no simulator run.
command: docker run --rm -e OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 -v /tmp/imgtest:/work:ro -w /work ghcr.io/ucb-bar/chia-champsim@sha256:610951d382f9e6cdfc51a4526ba70e36c80f3375b1dc19d60117bc47f20e94c4 python3 -m unittest discover -s chia_loop/tests
host: GCP compute instance chia-grid2, us-east1-b (sponsor-funded project, compute idle at run time)
tree_tested: chia_loop/ and scripts/ from the working tree after the nullity classification fix and its four tests; shipped as a tarball, extracted to /tmp/imgtest, mounted read-only. The VM working tree was not touched.
supersedes: results/grid_v7_gcp/provenance.json records unit_tests_in_image = 'Ran 34 tests / OK' from an earlier commit. 34 was correct then. This run covers the 43 tests present after the gate, label and nullity fixes.
note: The suite is pure Python and does not exercise the simulator; running it in the image establishes interpreter and dependency compatibility, not that any measurement reproduced.
